Gedankenverknüpfung: Current connection of thoughts governing how much and how long an object is represented through a word
Gedankenreihe: Sequence of thoughts expressed through several words yet considered one connected whole
Rede: Connected discourse whose divisions simultaneously reveal its construction as a whole
Ganzes: A connected whole in which parts and divisions acquire their function
Glied: Member within a connected thought sequence into which a word’s object is inserted
Vermittlung: Mediation through sounds by which objects are made into thoughts
Nüchternheit: Restraint in a word’s conceptual indication, supplying what use needs without distracting excess
Reinheit: Purity of conceptual indication without extraneous determination
Schärfe: Sharp determinacy of a word’s concept
Angemessenheit: Fit of a word’s conceptual formation to a clearly conceived purpose
Seelenstimmung: Orientation or mood of the soul accompanying differing ways of speaking about one object
sinnverwandte Wörter: Words related in meaning whose differences may arise from dialectal borrowing with associated concepts
Verstand: Understanding as the faculty distinguishing and retaining the basic elements of language
Gemüth: Affective disposition/power in which feelings and resonances are available, distinguished from intellectual powers while interacting with them
Gemüthskraft: Affective powers combined with intellectual powers in an overall orientation of expression
Gemüthsempfindung: A particular affective feeling revealed by emotionally marked expressions
Gesammtstimmung: Overall orientation of united intellectual and affective powers, contrasted with a single feeling
Volksdialect: Popular varieties contrasted with a higher purified variety in the author’s evaluative discussion of affective expression
Mundart: Variety of speech, here the higher/purified one contrasted with popular dialects
Prosa: Prose as a distinct kind of discourse with its own cultivated linguistic feeling
fesselfreie Rede: Unbound/nonmetrical discourse contrasted with specially poetic vocabulary
Dichtung: Poetic production contrasted with yet capable of joining abstract philosophy
Vernunft: Synthesizing reason producing philosophically rich expressions, distinguished from technical construction by Verstand
synthetisirend: Synthesizing action attributed to reason in creating philosophical expressions
Offenbarung: Higher disclosure/revelation distinguished from technical logical construction in the origin of philosophical expressions
Nachdenken: Reflective thinking through which philosophically rich concepts can arise
intellectuell: Pertaining to conceptual/intellectual powers distinguished from, yet combined with, affective powers
Vorrath: Available stock of words treated in its meanings and mutual relations
Redegebrauch: Use or purpose of discourse for which a language provides fitting expressions
Gedankenumfang: The range of thought of a nation at a given time, said to correspond to its language at that time
Identität: Identity of thinking and speaking invoked to justify expressive adequacy and continuing development
Sprechen: Speaking as the activity related identically to thinking in the account of a language’s expressive capacity
Thätigkeit: Activity in which intellectual existence consists and is concentrated in individual thinking
Keim: Germ of further development in everything already contained in a language
Entwicklung: Ongoing unfolding of possibilities within a language, not a closed inventory
mechanisch: Mechanical addition of parts, explicitly rejected as an adequate model of linguistic development
Fortschreiten: Advancement of language, explicitly qualified as unfolding rather than mechanical addition
Satz: proposition or assertion
organisch: Organic development expressly characterized as unfolding a whole from a whole
Entfalten: Unfolding a whole from an already given whole, contrasted with adding separate parts
Stempelung: Giving existing words a new conceptual impress within ongoing semantic development
Fixirung: Fixing/determining meanings in the language’s more inward further development
Modificirung: Modification of meanings distinguished from expansion of the sound stock
Scheidepunkt: Dividing point at which internal sound-stock expansion gives way to more inward semantic treatment, expressly underdetermined by historical evidence
Dialect: A language variety capable of enriching another variety and the general language
Reichthum: Richness as capacity to satisfy expression, under which criterion languages are equally rich; the following pages distinguish other degrees and kinds
Wortklang: A word’s sounded form in families developed from one base sound
Stamm: historical speaking group
Vermögen: Mental capacity/power whose relation and cooperation constitute the subjective form of a word
Geschlecht: family of word-sounds
Bedürfniss: Need for expression to which linguistic capacity is adequate
Erfahrung: Historical experience/attestation limiting claims about stages of sound-stock development
Schaffen: Creating sounds and concepts as distinguishable activities of linguistic growth, with different stated limits
Klang: Sound considered as part of a language’s available sound stock
unendlich: Unbounded continuation of conceptual creation contrasted with a limit to sound-stock creation
Umschreibung: Expression through several words rather than one word for the concept
Werkzeug des Denkens: Language as an instrument whose form acts back on thinking
Abgezogenheit: Bare abstractness of thought contrasted with language’s uptake of the form of external reality
Mittheilung: Communication of thoughts as the immediate purpose of discourse, distinguished from language’s wider effects on thinking
Ausdruck: Expression or an individual linguistic expression considered through its conceptual, affective, and apprehensional fit
Rückwirkung: Return influence of language’s form on thinking, distinguished from the immediate purpose of communicating thought
Wirklichkeit: External reality whose form language should take into its own form in the author’s argument about lexical richness
Fülle: Fullness of intellectual and sensory expression beyond minimally satisfying propositional content
Lebendigkeit: Liveliness of thought in its expression, distinguished from bare satisfaction of content
Sprachstoff: Linguistic material inseparable, in exact analysis, from the thought material it helps bring into being
Analogon: Practical analogue to the impossible strict comparison of a vocabulary with all pure concepts
Analyse: Strict exact analysis in which thought/concept and language cannot be cleanly separated; ordinary practical comparisons remain possible
das zu Bezeichnende: What is to be designated, whose conceptual emergence itself can depend on designation
Darstellung: Presentation of thought by linguistic means, assessable beyond bare satisfaction of content
Kategorie: General classifications of objects and concepts aiding lexical comparison, with a particular language required at the individual-concept level
Methode: Combination of cross-language attestation and general conceptual categorization as a sufficient, qualified research procedure
Form: activity or operations of thought
Verhältnissbegriff: concept of a relation
Eigenschaftsbegriff: Concept of a property, named through a suspended compound in the inventory of lexical content
Benennung: Naming of particular newly discovered objects, distinguished from subtler conceptual modifications
Modification: Modifications of intellectual concepts, a distinct historical research target from discovery/naming of physical things
Technik: A language’s procedure for indicating a concept both to understanding and to the ear
Bildungsstand: General state of cultivation invoked alongside custom and way of life to explain differences in lexical elaboration
Nation: Historically and culturally characterized speaking community to which language habits and word formation are attributed
Form: activity or operations of thought
Operation: Operations of thought such as connecting, separating, and comparing concepts
Handlung: inner act of thought
logische Wörter: Words concerning the form/activity of thinking and relations rather than objects or their qualities
dialektisch: Alternative label for words indicating thought operations and relations
Beziehung: Relation among concepts/things and to the understanding that thinks them
Verhältniss: Interrelation or relational determination of concepts/things, viewed through the understanding’s activity
subjectiv: Considered from the side of inner intellectual production
objectiv: Considered in relation to what the expressions indicate, here relations rather than objects or properties
unkörperlich: Noncorporeal content contrasted with bodily things in the matter of thought
Beschaffenheitswort: Word expressing a quality; lexical conceptual source for designation and formation
Bewegungswort: Word expressing movement/action as a general conceptual source
Beziehungswort: Word expressing relation, considered both as the understanding’s activity and as a relation viewed in objects
Verhältnisswort: Relational word named in a suspended compound with Beziehungswörter
Abzeichen: Overt grammatical indication distinguished from a word’s original lexical conceptual class
Substantivum: Noun category named within the author’s account of originally lexical and subsequently grammatical formation
Adjectivum: Adjective category, lexically grounded by the author in qualities and available for grammatical recasting
Adverbium: Adverb category named with adjectives in the three-way grouping of word kinds
Verbum: Verb category, including forms that can be built lexically from a prior verb and a stem
Grammatik: Grammatical formation which recasts words of one lexical conceptual class into others
Stamm: lexical base
grammatisch: Pertaining to the language’s grammatical formation/classification, distinguished from yet interacting with lexical conceptual class
Beschaffenheit: Quality or characteristic, distinguished from an object and an action as a lexical source of designation
Bewegung: Movement/action through which objects attract attention and receive designation
körperlich: Bodily/corporeal subject matter of thought contrasted with noncorporeal content
Classificirung: Classifying concepts to disclose the language’s procedure of designation
Bezeichnungsart: Manner of designation through related concepts, considered from subjective and objective sides
bezeichnender Begriff: Concept used to designate another, distinguished from the concept to be designated
Verständigung: Possibility of mutual understanding constraining how far a new expression or meaning may go beyond what is already understood
Verfahren: Procedure of inquiry, here comparing designating and designated concepts in both directions
Beschaffenheitsbegriff: General bodily quality concept used as material for designating other concepts
Bewegungsbegriff: General bodily movement/action concept used to designate others
Hauptstoff: Principal stock of bodily quality/action concepts from which further designations are drawn
Wurzelwort: Root word with both grammatical distribution and lexical derivational roles; not necessarily the universal origin of all other words
Grammatik: grammar as practical codification
Künstelei: Forced ingenious manipulation by which recalcitrant words are assigned to assumed roots
Agglutination: Named mode of derivation distinguished from inflection within productive vocabulary formation
Patronymicum: Patronymic class named as an example of rule-governed lexical formation
Gentilicium: Gentilic class named among rule-governed vocabulary formations
Abstractum: Abstract-word class in the enumeration of systematically formed vocabulary
Eigenthumswort: Class of possession/property expressions, later criticized as based on a particular factual relation rather than purely deducible categories
Causal-Verbum: Causal verb class named through a suspended compound as an example of rule-based word formation
Volitiv-Verbum: Volitive verb class enumerated as productive lexical formation
Bezeichnungsmethode: Rule-governed ways of making lexical expressions, conventionally placed in grammars though they concern vocabulary formation
Wortvorrath: Stock of words whose productive formation is distinguished from connecting words in discourse
Wortreichthum: Richness of vocabulary increased by productive word families as well as separate new expressions
Eintheilungsgrund: Principle of division whose possible kinds should be comprehended and exhausted in a rule-governed family
Gattung: Kind or class of words/concepts formed and assessed by a shared classificatory principle
Regel: A regular principle governing whether concept-classes are designated through composition or learned derivation, contrasted with chance
Gesetz: Learned regularity governing derivation, contrasted with immediately intelligible composition
Umänderung: Rule-governed alteration of existing word-sounds in productive lexical families
Verbindung: Combination of words in discourse, distinguished from formation of vocabulary
Sphäre: range of possible sound positions
Zweckmässigkeit: Fitness to a logical purpose in choosing rule-governed formation and expressing related conceptual classes
Wechselbeziehung: Mutual relation of concepts filling a common sphere, potentially indicated in the expressions themselves
Vollständigkeit: Completeness of expressing the mutually related concepts belonging to a sphere
Sprachbezeichnung: Linguistic designation considered for systematic conceptual adequacy and completeness
Material: The vocabulary’s material provided for discourse after analysis of sound forms, concepts, and designating resources
Wortgehalt: The word’s content, of which accompanying feeling had so far been considered one part
Gefühl: unreflective subjective orientation including intellect
Eigenthümlichkeit: Distinctive character of a nation manifested in a language’s habitual subjective orientation
Absonderung: Analytic separating of aspects, which need not correspond to different objects; elsewhere physical separation of noise from sound
Richtung: Direction or orientation of intellectual activity contained even within the broad feeling under study
Stimmung: Intellectual disposition or attunement which characterizes expressions and their use
Ideenverknüpfung: Connection of ideas, here a practical/light mode in which a language’s orientation may keep thought
Zusammenfügung: Putting discourse together, another domain in which the same subjective linguistic orientation appears
Sprachbau: Structure of language across parts in which a common orientation can recur
Geistesrichtung: A nation’s intellectual orientation, changeable through apprehension and the influence of expressions or individual authors
Geistesbildung: Intellectual cultivation whose history includes changes in a language’s subjective effects
Sprachkunde: Study of language which may narrowly restrict itself to more material aspects, though the present inquiry demands fuller relation to humans
Umformung: Reshaping of sounds, distinguished from changes in subjective apprehension and broad meanings
Umwandlung: Transformations of language’s subjective intellectual/affective orientation, potentially faster and stronger than sound change
literarische Denkmäler: Literary records needed to trace subjective/evaluative linguistic changes not visible in isolated words
Wirkung: Effect which can in turn become a cause in reciprocal subjective word formation and use
Ursache: Cause whose role alternates with effect in the account of word formation and apprehension
